description_en: Modifies the zones and vSwitches that are associated with a virtual private cloud (VPC) connection
description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentZones接口修改专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）连接关联的可用区和交换机
kebab_example: aliyun cbn update-transit-router-vpc-attachment-zones --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --dry-run false --transit-router-attachment-id tr-attach-9bbqyygouv4cpn0000 --add-zone-mappings ZoneId=cn-hangzhou-h VSwitchId=vsw-wz988dda8ldm4uvmx0000 --remove-zone-mappings ZoneId=cn-hangzhou-i VSwitchId=vsw-wz9f5izl6wshndmta0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentZones

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not set this parameter, ClientToken is set to the value of RequestId. The value of RequestId for each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改VPC连接的可用区和交换机。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接修改VPC连接的可用区和交换机
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC connection
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch that you want to add to the VPC connection.

You can specify at most 10 vSwitches in each call.

If the VPC connection belongs to the current Alibaba Cloud account, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35748.html operation to query the IDs of the vSwitches and zones of the VPC.
If the VPC connection belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/427599.html operation to query the IDs of the vSwitches and zones of the VPC
fields.help_zh:
待为VPC连接添加的交换机ID。

一次最多支持添加10个交换机。

如果您当前登录的阿里云账号和VPC实例属于同一个账号，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35748.html接口查询VPC实例下交换机ID及其所属可用区的ID。
如果您当前登录的阿里云账号和VPC实例属于不同的账号，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/427599.html接口查询VPC实例下交换机ID及其所属可用区的ID。

当填写VSwitchId后ZoneId为必填
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the zone where the vSwitch that you want to add to the VPC connection is deployed.

You can specify at most 10 vSwitches in each call
fields.help_zh:
待为VPC连接添加的交换机所属的可用区ID。

一次最多支持添加10个交换机。

当填写ZoneId后VSwitchId为必填
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The zones and vSwitches that you want to add to the VPC connection
parameters.help_zh: 待为VPC连接添加的可用区和交换机列表
parameters.name: add_zone_mappings

fields.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch that you want to remove from the VPC connection.

You can remove at most 10 vSwitches from a VPC in each call
fields.help_zh:
待为VPC连接删除的交换机ID。

一次最多支持删除10个交换机。

当填写VSwitchId后ZoneId为必填
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the zone where the vSwitch that you want to remove from the VPC connection is deployed
fields.help_zh:
待为VPC连接删除的交换机所属的可用区ID。

一次最多支持删除10个交换机。

当填写ZoneId后VSwitchId为必填
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The zones and vSwitches that you want to remove from the VPC connection
parameters.help_zh: 待为VPC连接删除的可用区和交换机列表
